10.t: Working with data: is it a fair test?
q: What is the independent variable in this test?
The volume of water soaked up (mL).
Identify two control variables that were not kept the same.
Size of sheet (B was bigger) and time in water (C was 30 s); the volume of water also changed for C.
The student says brand B is best. Evaluate this conclusion and describe how to make the test fair.
Not valid: B had a sheet four times larger, so it would soak up more anyway. Use the same size (10 cm × 10 cm), the same time and the same volume of water for every brand, then repeat three times.
